QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Another Me?
QuestInfo.0: You collected 50 #t4000436# items from #o4250000#s and brought them to Loha, but that actually made Loha angrier. Tess might've told you to get the wrong items.
QuestInfo.1: Head over to Athena Pierce at the Altaire Camp Conference Room. She might be able to explain this whole situation and who Kao is.
QuestInfo.2: You met Athena Pierce at the Altaire Camp Conference Room. She looks no different...

0.0: Wow, you're just so good at wasting time, aren't you?
0.1: Well, go find Athena Pierce. She was looking for you, and you don't want to keep her waiting.

yes.0: Not going to ask who Athena Pierce is? Huh. Well, she must be at the Camp Conference Room. As for me, I'll find someone else to get food for the baby. Thanks for nothing.

no.0: Why? Afraid she's not going to appreciate your little joke? Well, come back when you're ready to face the music.

1.0: Kao?\r\n#L0##bNo, not Kao... I came from the future...#l\n#k
1.1: Ah. No need for details... It is plain to see that you are different.

yes.0: Could you give me a second?

npc.0: Athena Pierce is at the Camp Conference Room. Just go see her.
